headline: China Resumes US Soybean Purchases, Importing 4.3 Million Tons in Sep-Oct
summary: China purchased roughly 4.3 million metric tons of US soybeans across September and October, compared to negligible volumes a year earlier during trade friction.
why: China is the world's largest importer of soybeans, making its purchasing volume a key determinant of global agricultural commodity prices.

impacts.name: Soybeans
impacts.why: Increased export demand from Chinese buyers supports agricultural futures prices.
